title: Causal Inference for Sequential Settings under Interference and Latent Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2607.14940v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study causal inference under outcome interference for sequential, observational settings. Specifically, we consider settings where the binary outcomes over N units are Markovian across T time steps. At each time step, the outcomes of N units have dependencies captured through an Ising model; each outcome is also impacted through an external field capturing the effects of its treatment as well as latent confounders. Similar to panel data literature, these latent confounders are modeled to have a low-rank factor structure. Our data is a single sample from this high-dimensional distribution. To estimate causal quantities of interest, we provide a computationally efficient method based on Maximum Pseudo-Likelihood Estimation (MPLE) for learning the model parameters. Under mild assumptions, we establish non-asymptotic consistency for parameter estimation and show this translates to faithful estimation of causal quantities of interest a

translated_title: 干扰与潜在混杂因素下序贯设置的因果推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究序贯观测设置下存在结果干扰的因果推断问题。具体而言，我们考虑N个单元的二元结果在T个时间步上具有马尔可夫性的设置。在每个时间步，N个单元结果之间的依赖关系通过Ising模型来刻画；每个结果还受到一个外部场的影响，该外部场捕获了其处理效应以及潜在混杂因素的作用。与面板数据文献类似，这些潜在混杂因素被建模为具有低秩因子结构。我们的数据是来自该高维分布的单一样本。为了估计感兴趣的因果量，我们提供了一种基于最大伪似然估计（MPLE）的计算高效方法来学习模型参数。在温和的假设下，我们建立了参数估计的非渐近一致性，并证明这可以转化为对感兴趣的因果量的忠实估计。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于最大伪似然估计的计算高效方法，用于在存在结果干扰和低秩潜在混杂因素的序贯观测设置中估计因果效应，并证明了参数估计的非渐近一致性及其向因果量的忠实估计转化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a computationally efficient Maximum Pseudo-Likelihood Estimation (MPLE) method for causal inference in sequential observational settings with outcome interference and low-rank latent confounding, establishing non-asymptotic consistency guarantees for parameter estimation that translate to faithful estimation of causal quantities.
